# tools: investigate possibilities of devenv

Look at [devenv](https://devenv.sh), the Nix-based tool for reproducible per-project developer environments (`devenv.nix` declaring languages, services, scripts; `devenv shell`). **Motivation:** "it looks promising" — the follow-up to the general Nix research of [[DOT-144]], narrowed to the developer-environment use case.
